**INCIDENT DIRECTIVE — [Cluster name]**

**From:** [Your name], [role]
**Time issued:** [timestamp, UTC]
**To:** SRE on-call

**Situation:** [State the observable symptoms: alerts fired, error rates, affected services, duration. Do not state cause unless verified.]

**Directive:** I am ordering the following actions, effective immediately:

1. Take snapshots/backups of all persistent volumes in scope before any deletion. Confirm snapshot completion and record snapshot IDs in the incident channel before proceeding.
2. Execute cluster rollback to [known-good version/manifest, with commit or version ID].
3. Purge persistent volumes listed in [appendix/scope] only after step 1 is confirmed.
4. Report completion and post-rollback health checks to this channel.

**Scope:** [Exact volumes/namespaces — enumerate; do not leave open-ended.]
**Rollback point:** [Version/commit/tag]
**Data owner sign-off:** [Name, or state explicitly that this could not be obtained and why]

**Rationale:** [Your stated reason, attributed to you as the decision-maker.]
